prompt:
Fix snippets/local-currency-notice.liquid. It shows shoppers which other currencies prices are also displayed in. Right now duplicate currency entries appear more than once. Inputs (all top-level variables, none under section.settings): - `currencies`: array of objects, never null, may be empty. Each object has `code` (string of 2-4 uppercase letters, never null, e.g. "EUR") and `label` (non-empty string, never null, may contain < > & " characters). - `shop_currency`: string, never null, the store's own currency code, e.g. "USD". Behavior: - Walk `currencies` in array order. - Skip any entry whose `code` equals `shop_currency` (exact match). - Skip any entry whose `code` exactly equals the code of an entry already included earlier. Only the first occurrence of a code is kept, together with its own label. Matching is on the whole code: a code that is merely a prefix or substring of an earlier code (e.g. "AU" after "AUD") is a different code and must be included. - Each included entry becomes the text `LABEL (CODE)`, where LABEL is the HTML-escaped label and CODE is the code. - Join included entries with `, ` (comma and one space). Output, exactly and with no whitespace or newlines before, after or inside the element other than the text shown: `

Also shown in: ENTRIES

` If no entry is included (empty array, or every entry skipped), output nothing at all (empty string). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/local-currency-notice.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
